items.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Apache Iceberg table optimization in the US West (N. California) Region
items.content_snippet: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports automatic table optimization for Apache Iceberg tables in the US West (N. California) Region. Apache Iceberg is an open table format that delivers fast query performance over large tables in data lakes. With this launch, you can enable table optimization for individual tables or for all tables in your Data Catalog. items.content_snippet: Today, AWS announces that AWS partners who operate multiple legal entities can publish a product listing once in their primary account and enable their local subsidiaries to sell it through direct private offers — eliminating the need to recreate and maintain duplicate listings across every account. items.content_snippet: Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Amazon RDS for Oracle now support RDS storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes . RDS storage autoscaling automatically scales storage capacity in response to growing database workloads, with zero downtime. Watch how Howie turns business data into decisions while the work is still happening.

items.title: Your Agent Just Paid for Nothing: 6 Attacks on x402 Payments - Ishween Kaur, SoFi
items.content_snippet: x402 lets AI agents pay for data and APIs with tiny on-chain payments over HTTP. Ishween Kaur explains how the protocol works, then walks through six of the 20 ways she broke it in a safe test environment: price changes in the payment header, paying twice, getting data for free, one payment unlocking many pages, lookalike sellers, and prompt injection that talks an agent into paying again. For each one, she shows the guard that stopped it and how to roll out agent payments safely, trace by trace

items.title: The Cheaper AI Model That Costs You More - Rayan Krishnan, Vals AI
items.content_snippet: Vals AI builds benchmarks that frontier labs cite in their model cards, and Rayan Krishnan explains why those single scores hide a jagged frontier. items.title: Why Humans Can't Keep Up With AI-Written Code - Tariq Shaukat, Sonar
